name: @projexlight/sdk-billing
summary: Operational billing for ProjexCloud: per-tenant invoice generation from metered usage, live-meter accrual for in-period dashboards, reprice dry-runs for pricing-change impact analysis, per-BU showback aggregation, and the dunning state machine for overdue invoices. Pinned to a pricing-catalog version per invoice so historical billing stays reproducible after rate changes.

endpoints.description: Generate an invoice for a tenant + period from accumulated meter rows; pins the pricing-catalog version at finalization.
Live in-period meter accrual for the calling tenant: subtotal, per-SKU units + amount, meter-lag in ms.
Apply a candidate pricing catalog to historical usage rows; returns the would-be invoice without committing.
Per-BU (business-unit) usage breakdown for the period; powers internal chargeback dashboards.

events.name: billing.invoice.generated.v1
events.description: New invoice in 'draft'; carries period bounds + pricing_catalog_version.

events.name: billing.invoice.finalized.v1
events.description: Invoice locked + immutable; downstream payment + audit pipelines key off this.

events.name: billing.invoice.voided.v1
events.description: Invoice voided; emits a compensating event rather than mutating the row.

events.name: billing.reprice.completed.v1
events.description: Dry-run finished; carries the diff vs. the current catalog.

events.name: billing.showback.refreshed.v1
events.description: Showback aggregation finished; consumed by tenant-admin Billing UI.

events.name: billing.dunning.advanced.v1
events.description: Dunning state machine moved the invoice forward (notice → second-notice → suspension).

models.description: Header row per (tenant, period); pins pricing_catalog_version + currency + total.
One row per SKU per invoice; carries units, rate, amount, source meter run id.
Per-invoice dunning state machine: current_state, last_notice_at, next_action_at, severity.
Reprice dry-run inputs + outputs; expires after 30 days.
Per-(tenant, sku) soft-cap watermark; powers the WARN-header middleware in the gateway.

hooks.name: registerStripeForInvoicePush
hooks.description: Wire a Stripe adapter so finalized invoices auto-push to Stripe as draft invoices for collection.

hooks.name: registerDunningWorkflow
hooks.description: Plug an external workflow (e.g. CRM ticket) into the dunning advance events.

hooks.name: registerPostFinalizeHook
hooks.description: Fire arbitrary tenant-side webhooks on billing.invoice.finalized.v1.

scenarios.title: Generate and finalize the monthly invoice for a tenant
scenarios.when_to_use: End-of-period close. Pulls the tenant's metered usage for [start, end), prices it against the published catalog, writes the invoice + line items.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns an invoice with status='finalized', pricing_catalog_version pinned, and 1 row per SKU in billing.line_item. Emits billing.invoice.generated.v1 + .finalized.v1.

scenarios.title: Render the in-period live meter on the tenant Billing page
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer admin opens /billing in the tenant-admin console; we show subtotal + per-SKU units accrued so far this period.
scenarios.example_code:
const r = await fetch(`/api/billing/live?tenant_id=${tid}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${jwt}` } });
const { subtotal, by_sku, lag_ms } = (await r.json()).data;
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the rolling-window aggregate. Updated within ~60 s of meter ingest (FR-BIL-7). lag_ms tells you how stale the rollup is.

scenarios.title: Model the impact of a proposed quarterly price bump
scenarios.when_to_use: Finance is proposing a 10% rate hike on vault.encrypt. Run dry-run on a representative cohort to estimate revenue impact before publishing the new catalog.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns baseline + candidate totals + per-SKU breakdown. Stored in billing.reprice_dry_run for 30 days for follow-up analysis. Does NOT touch invoice.

scenarios.title: Per-BU chargeback aggregation
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer wants to split ProjexCloud spend across their internal cost centers (engineering, sales, support).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns aggregated usage by business unit. Tenant-admin Billing page uses this for the chargeback view; CSV export available.

scenarios.title: Dunning state machine advances overdue invoice
scenarios.when_to_use: Background worker discovers an invoice past its grace period; the dunning state machine advances notice → second-notice → suspension.
scenarios.expected_outcome: billing.dunning_state row updated. Emits billing.dunning.advanced.v1 carrying old + new state. Customer admin can override via tenant-admin Billing approval gate.

compliance_posture.notes: Invoice immutability via finalized event + compensating-void pattern satisfies SOX revenue-recognition controls. PCI scope minimized: this SDK NEVER stores PANs — payment provider tokens live in sdk-payment + sdk-vault. Dunning notices are tenant-admin-configurable to honor customer-defined grace periods.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per invoice generated (free up to plan ceiling)
